WebSocket-companion catch-up for the Verifiable Trust subscribe stream. Returns the same change envelopes as the `/v4/verifiable-trust/subscribe` WS `block` messages, compressed: blocks with no subscribed change are omitted. Use after a disconnection or a detected gap, looping with `nextFromBlock` until it is `null`.
